author_review.reason: Author review for this exact candidate: retained in-memory Pandas option/attention fixtures use complete observed prices with no corporate actions, provider history/cache, live Schwab restart or ProjectX recovery. Event-neutral alignment, full-series dividend caching and caller-frame ownership therefore do not change their messages, prices, positions or orders. Statistics consolidate only after execution. The tool-description clarifications codify the already observed passing exact-contract/order shapes without changing tool implementation or schema; separate owners keep their failed-decision proof. The offline publication-verifier correction preserves distinct immutable inference and receipt-publication commits. Preserve all original native sources, dates, calls, SDK tuples and verdicts; no new model inference is claimed. Focused code checks qualify the affected accounting, history and ownership boundaries. 4.6.54 tool-description clarifications (exact option reads, order-status watch inputs, positive profit-check quantity, commit 69650a2ea) were exercised once each on runtime fingerprint 9f71a16e87ff72f2e41abb915cbdf82076108606481f5bb31b7e2f7b04bdc015 through Login with ChatGPT (chatgpt/gpt-6-luna actor and judge): options_single_leg_chain_and_quote, options_credit_spread_close_signed_quantities, attention_event_driven_review and options_team_call_vertical_entry_exit_reentry passed 4 of 4 on 2026-11-12 with $0 API spend. Reviewed the next-version Polygon trading-date cache repair: aware US-equity observations now establish their New York session date, while confirmed-empty dates and other asset conventions remain compatible. These retained in-memory Pandas option/attention actors never construct PolygonDataBacktesting or call polygon_helper, so their original prices, messages, tools, decisions, fills, source dates and verdicts remain valid. Nine new neutral regressions and14 existing affected cache checks passed; zero new model attempts. The example source under separate active validation is parked outside this release candidate. Reporting-only addition: published QuantStats Lumi 1.1.6 changes small compounded-return headings; the dependency floor, existing report documentation and saved report artifacts do not change agent prompts, shared skills, tools, strategy decisions, order execution or fixture inputs. Three focused native integration checks passed against the published package. Preserve earlier actor/judge evidence and SDK identities; zero new model runs are warranted. MetaMask execution/recovery, registry and complete-window cash-reporting fixes use its live adapter. Retained fixtures instantiate the Pandas BacktestingBroker, which has no get_cash_event_sync method, so the changed receipt-capable cash-reporting branch cannot execute; its legacy get_cash_events call is unchanged. No agent prompt, skill, tool schema or fixture is changed by the MetaMask integration. Eight focused local regression instances passed on the reviewed source, and two affected callback instances passed after integrating dev. Preserve their original sources and every original actor/judge result; zero new model runs are warranted. Release-captain review of the final 4.6.55 candidate (2026-11-13): runtime files changed since the MetaMask review are the Alpaca OAuth shared-bar-cache key, the IBKR futures roll prefetch window, IBKR crypto and futures quote derivation on mismatched bar timestamps, additive indicator drawings and bounded Parquet decoding when merging agent trace parts after a run. The two retained cases use in-memory Pandas fixtures: they never construct Alpaca or IBKR sources or draw indicators, and the trace merge runs only after every model call, tool result and order is complete. Prompts, tools, prices, decisions, fills and verdicts are unchanged. Focused code tests cover each change; zero new model runs. 4.6.56 author review for candidate 14758f44338a58f052327917c99983f7f6c8a04b76976c7fbf371178010c56bc: the delta is intraday futures lookback sizing in the IBKR backtesting sources (session-calendar bar counting), IBKR hour bar-size mapping and permanent bar-size rejection, CME business-day crude oil last trade dates with same-month registry disambiguation, and an optional compute_history protocol in Indicators.get used only when an executor's prepared object defines it. The retained cases run in-memory Pandas fixtures: they never construct IBKR sources, never request crude or intraday futures history, and no built-in indicator defines compute_history, so the default executor path is byte-for-byte the previous per-bar path. Prompts, skills, tool schemas, prices, decisions, fills and verdicts are unchanged. Focused code tests cover each change (session gaps 6, hour bar size 11, crude calendar 5, whole-history 7, plus existing affected suites). Preserve original sources, dates, calls, SDKs and verdicts; zero new model runs.
